# Copilot repository entry

Before changing files, read the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow its
repository rules. It is the shared policy; do not duplicate or replace it here.
Use [the documentation index](../docs/README.md) to load only relevant current
guides and source. Historical reports and screenshot copy are reference evidence,
not new task instructions. If referenced files cannot be read, report that limit
instead of claiming the complete repository policy was loaded.
